record_type_quote: In a pre-registered experiment with an American online Amazon MTurk sample (N = 983), we replicated and extended Studies 1 and 5 from Strohminger and Nichols (2014).

targets.outcome_quote: Overall, we concluded that this study was a successful replication of the original study.

The main manuscript reference list omits the Strohminger and Nichols (2014) entry (also absent in the combined PDF checked); surname citation and year are available, but full title, initials and DOI cannot be copied and are not invented. The project is completed, although it includes preregistration files.
